pretreatments.description: Thermophilic Pretreatment (TPP) of food waste (FW) and inoculum together, followed by a reduction to mesophilic conditions (35 ± 2 °C). This involves heating the mixture containing both the substrate and inoculum to varying temperatures (50, 60, 70, or 80 °C) for a specific duration (12, 24, 36, or 48 hours) before switching to mesophilic conditions for digestion.

Conventional Thermal Pretreatment (CTP) of food waste (FW), followed by inoculation in bottles and incubation at mesophilic conditions (35 ± 2 °C). This involves heating only the FW substrate to varying temperatures (50–80 °C) for a specific duration (1.5, 6, 12, or 24 hours) prior to adding the inoculum.
